text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I stepped outside after finishing shopping, it was pouring rain. With the strong winds, it was foul weather indeed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fortunately, I had brought an umbrella. Just as I was about to watch my step and head back—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A drop of sin...
This is none other than heaven's wrath...
choice_data_list: Are you okay?! You're going to catch a cold……!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Oh.
An academy Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you for your consideration.
However――

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
This too is a trial for a saint.
I shall dispel it with my "Power to Banish Evil"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What could this mean...? Just as I was wondering—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Schwing! Schwing! Swoosh...
SCHWING――!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She struck a mysterious pose――and began to pray.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now, in the name of the Saint,
holy droplets of the heavens, be stilled――!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: O sunlight, shine upon the earthâ!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perplexed by what this could be,
the emotion that welled up within my chest was――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No, but stillââ
The rain shows no sign of letting up at all...!
choice_data_list: I'll go buy an umbrella, wait here!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No, there is no problem.
And that is because—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —The holy maiden Red Desire, destined to one day reach "that promised land."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
As long as I do not doubt, waver, or lose faith in myself……
I know my prayers will be answered. Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A pure smile. An unshakeable heart that never doubts itself... I found myself understanding why she calls herself a saint.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I bought an umbrella at a nearby convenience store
and headed back to Red Desire.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: To think you would go to the trouble of preparing an umbrella for me... I am truly grateful.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: However, to cause you such worry... I still have much to learn as a holy maiden...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
――Ah, by the way, Trainer,
you weren't too cold in the rain, were you?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Should you require it, I shall manifest the holy light
and grant you warmth.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Should you ever need anything, however,
please do not hesitate to ask me, your saintly maiden.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She truly seems to believe from the bottom of her heart that she is a holy maiden.
What an utterly mysterious—and strong-willed—girl.
choice_data_list: Make sure you warm up properly once you get home, okay?
Let's treat the trek back home as today's trial.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Understood. In order to discipline myself for failing to overcome the ordeal――

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Shall we dive right in,
into the scalding hot spring water.
choice_data_list: Y-You don't need to go that far...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because of her overly strong convictions, she could be somewhat reckless.
I thought to myself that I'd better keep an eye on her
from time to time going forward.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I see...
Charge forward without looking back, is it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Well then, that is what I shall do.
Trusting with all my heart—that this path leads
to one of hope, toward an alternate world.
